newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open mostly flat on Monday, based on market orders at 1018 EDT, traders said.
Players are expected to remain focused on rolling May positions ahead of the first notice day on April 24. Open interest remained high at 17,019 lots as of Thursday's close.
Open interest in July stood at 65,598 lots, up 866 lots.
Cold, wet conditions in south Texas may delay planting. Some replanting or crop changes may occur, Weather Services Corp, said.

NYCE cotton futures settled modestly higher on Friday as traders rolled over their May positions. The spot month closed 0.11 cent higher at 70.86 cents a lb while the rest of the board ended 0.08 to 0.10 cent firmer.
